It looks as if you are trying to link a 32bit Stan executable to a 64bit version on R. Do you have x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ also?

Ben

Thank you for your response.

I think you have to put in your Makevars file

CXX=x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++

instead of

CXX=i686-w64-mingw32-g++

Ben
